first_passage: passage: 실습 파일 보관 실습 파일은 개인 폴더에 보관합니다.
sql_schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS day23_search_docs (
    id integer PRIMARY KEY,
    title text NOT NULL,
    content text NOT NULL,
    category text NOT NULL,
    source_version text NOT NULL,
    embedding_model text NOT NULL,
    embedding vector(384) NOT NULL
)
sql_topk:
SELECT id,title,content,category,source_version,
     embedding_model,embedding <=> %s AS distance
FROM day23_search_docs WHERE embedding_model=%s
ORDER BY embedding <=> %s ASC LIMIT %s
sql_filtered:
SELECT id,title,content,category,source_version,
     embedding_model,embedding <=> %s AS distance
FROM day23_search_docs
WHERE embedding_model=%s AND category=%s
ORDER BY embedding <=> %s ASC LIMIT %s
